aggregation.accuracy: Mean and sample SD of three repetition accuracies
aggregation.api_time: Mean of three repetition means, entire actual trajectory; shared initial once per standalone arm
aggregation.cost: Mean of three per-repetition known-usage mean costs; unknown counts retained; missing all-known basis remains unavailable
aggregation.strict_cost: Also reports full-run mean cost only when every record has complete usage/rates
aggregation.paired_ci: Mean differences per example ID, then 2000 ID bootstrap samples with seed 1729
aggregation.quantiles: Per-repetition and pooled p50/p95 reported separately; neither is a quantile of repetition means
aggregation.retry_errors: Retry waits excluded from API time; failed unsaved attempts may add invoice spend beyond recorded standalone cost

benchmark_notes.bfcl: Pinned single-turn subset; main accuracy excludes 16 live-relevance cases; timings/cost include all 3051; exploratory settings selected on these examples
benchmark_notes.apibank: Exploratory adapted first-call exact match on 156 test cases; common native-candidate instruction amended after format-pilot test outcomes were inspected, then checked on four common development cases; r/threshold/fallback unchanged. Fixed 53-tool catalog; not native execution accuracy and no no-call negatives. Earlier original/user-turn format pilots excluded and retained.

input_adapter.applies_to: Every prepared example, every model, Direct and DMFC
input_adapter.instruction: Produce the next function-call candidate for the preceding conversation using the native structured tool-call interface. A tool-call candidate is only a proposal: the evaluator will not execute functions. Use only documented parameters and values supported by the conversation.
input_adapter.prior_runs_status: Original and common-user-turn runs retained as exploratory protocol/format pilots
input_adapter.protocol_reason: The original API-Bank input caused Claude to reject assistant prefill (HTTP 400). The first common user-turn format pilot was then inspected on the test split: GPT mini returned textual descriptions of the next API call with empty native call lists in all 468 Direct records. This second compatibility amendment explicitly requests a native structured call candidate. Test outcomes had already been inspected; earlier inputs and all three-model format-pilot results are retained as exploratory, and this amendment is not a fresh untouched-test evaluation.
input_adapter.validation_plan: Fixed common development cases first, then one fixed full test protocol for all three generators
